scripts.server:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml -f deploy/compose.dev.yml --env-file deploy/.env up -d --build
scripts.server:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml -f deploy/compose.dev.yml --env-file deploy/.env down
scripts.server:logs: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml -f deploy/compose.dev.yml --env-file deploy/.env logs -f server
